summary: Ro Khanna backed a permanent ceasefire by November 21, 2023, and now calls for ending U.S. military aid to Israel. He sponsors genocide recognition and UNRWA restoration. His record remains mixed: he backed aid-promising resolutions, Palestinian-targeted sanctions and measures restricting Palestinian advocacy, while USCPR rates his current Congress C and lifetime D. In January 2026, he voted for an aid package funding Israel and defunding UNRWA; he said Republicans had “snuck” provisions into it. His February No on a later package and separate restoration cosponsorship do not erase that Yes.
